Noah is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He is the former commanding officer of the 21st Division of the Demon Slayers, "Silver Knights" and a frequent Summoner who accepts Raid Mission requests from Elise. During his time as a Commander, he was given high expectations until the failure in completing the mission assigned for him to do, he left the division and returned to the Regular Army as a common Summoner.


==Debut Appearance==
After Elise calls the Summoner in order to defeat the demon Reduhark, Noah suddenly appeared and called the Summoner a "little weakling". Noah later became rivals with the Summoner during Raid Missions.
